nodes.label: mql Shared Value Language
nodes.rationale: One order-preserving parser into bson.D for all editors removes 'works in one editor but not another' bugs and keeps BSON types exact.

nodes.label: Services Behind Interfaces
nodes.rationale: Each feature package exposes a Service interface depending only on mongox.Source, not Wails or storage, keeping services testable and reusable (e.g. by a future CLI).

nodes.label: Safe Document Identity ($eq on _id)
nodes.rationale: Using $eq on exact _id prevents regex _id pattern matching; replace refuses _id change and reports NOT_FOUND instead of silent upsert.

nodes.label: Cancellation and Resource Safety
nodes.rationale: Every UI call has a timeout context; operations register an ID for cancel, re-runs supersede; cursors closed with fresh context; pages fetched as limit+1 so full result sets are never loaded.

nodes.label: Errors Are Data (apperr.Error)
nodes.rationale: Backend errors become apperr.Error{code,message,detail} serialized as JSON across the bridge so the UI can show friendly titles per code.

nodes.label: P1 Reuses P0 Services
nodes.rationale: SQL feeds query/aggregate services, export reuses query.Parse, explain and codegen reuse aggregate.Build, so paging, timeouts, read-only checks and parsing behave identically.

nodes.label: Long Work Is a Job, Not a Call
nodes.rationale: Imports/exports outlive a UI request; jobs get cancellable contexts, concurrency limit 2, panic recovery, ~7/s throttled progress pushed as jobs:update events so the UI never blocks.
nodes.norm_label: long work is a job, not a call

nodes.label: Streaming Everywhere
nodes.rationale: Readers/writers handle one document at a time; imports batch writes, exports iterate a cursor, so memory is independent of dataset size.

nodes.label: Credential Handling (OS keychain / AES-GCM file)
nodes.rationale: Passwords split from URI and stored in OS credential store or AES-256-GCM encrypted file; guards against casual disclosure but not a local attacker with account file access.

nodes.label: Atomic Export (temp file + rename)
nodes.rationale: Exports write to a temp file renamed on success so failed or canceled exports leave nothing behind.
